Definition: Shelomoth, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Shelomoth or Shelomith = "peaceful"; 1) a Gershonite Levite, son of Shimei in the time of David; 2) a Kohathite Levite of the sons of Izhar in the time of David; 3) a Gershonite Levite, son of Zichri in the time of David
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
